summary: melee or thrown weapon along +Z: blade, head or body up, grip down; no barrel, magazine or flash.

overall.summary: the whole weapon from both sides

blade.summary: blade, head or body, its edge and tip

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.

items.name: Blade or head
items.construction: the blade (knife, katana), head (bat, club, nightstick) or body (grenade, spray can) along +Z: lofted or lathed with a bevelled edge

items.name: Grip
items.construction: the grip along -Z below the blade: lathe or loft with a slight taper and a soft section

items.name: Guard or collar
items.construction: a guard, ferrule or collar where the blade meets the grip (a flat disc, a cross bar or a ring)

items.name: Pommel or end cap
items.construction: the pommel or end cap at the bottom of the grip, rounded

items.name: Photo texture
items.construction: small soft photo texture: metal sheen on the blade, wrap or wood on the grip

items.name: Edge or striking face
items.construction: the cutting edge or striking face as a bevel band along the blade (inset and scale)

items.name: Grip wrap or rings
items.construction: wrap ridges, rings or rivets on the grip as geometry where they read

items.name: Fittings
items.construction: rivets, a lanyard hole, a tang end or a cap screw as the design has them
